text:
Theo: Quick pulse check 100: planning a 'Collectible Console Night' Thursday after work. Theme: handhelds, weird controllers, retro peripherals. Bring any odd pads or a Game Boy for link-cable chaos. Anyone in? :game_die: :handshake:

Anya: Love the theme. I have a Game Boy Advance + link cable and a stack of Pokemon Mystery Dungeon cartridges.

Marco: I'm down. Can bring an N64 with that one yellow controller that has seen better days. Also a dial-up sound effect for ambience.

Jen: I can bring my wireless arcade stick and a packet of gummy bears. Also curious if we can do a micro-tournament for GoldenEye or Mario Kart.

Theo: micro-tourney sounds fun. Winners get bragging rights and maybe a tiny prize (leftover swag). Low-pressure.

Anya: totally in for GoldenEye nostalgia. Marco, you in for setting up an emu or OG console?

Marco: I'll bring the N64 and a multi-cart adapter. If we need emu for save states/quickmatch, I can spin up a Raspberry Pi.

Jen: ops-bot, can we reserve the middle lounge 6:30-9:30pm please? TV + HDMI preferred for projector-like setup.

ops-bot: Reservation requested for Middle Lounge 6:30-9:30pm. Please confirm setup: "TV+HDMI" or "Projector".

Theo: TV+HDMI. Also does anyone have extra RCA adapters for N64 -> HDMI converter?

Marco: I have an HDMI converter + RCA cables.

Anya: snacks? I can bring microwave popcorn (labeled).

Jen: i'll bring gummy bears and some labeled nut-free trail mix.

music-bot: queued playlist: "Chiptune Chill" -> "Arcade Classics" -> "Synthwave Warmup"

Theo: remote folks welcome. We'll set up a Steam Remote Play lobby for anything switch/pc-based. If you're remote and want to volunteer for commentary during GoldenEye, we'll stream low-ish lag via Discord.

Marco: small note: bring controllers with batteries charged. the N64 one eats AA's.

Anya: lol noted. Also quick poll: prefer GoldenEye or Mario Kart as the main micro-tourny? Reply with GOLDEN or KART.

Theo: GOLDEN

Marco: GOLDEN

Jen: KART (for chaos and gummy bear bribery)

Theo: looks GoldenEye wins by a hair. We'll do a short Mario Kart fun round between brackets for silliness.

ops-bot: Reminder: please label food for allergens and clear AV after event.

Theo: Great. I'll post a quick sign-up and a rough schedule tomorrow (6:30 setup, 7:00 games start, 8:45 final-ish). Thanks team 10: low-key, nostalgic vibes only. :tv: :joystick:
